win64-enterprise/opt:
    description: "Win64 Enterprise Opt (Cross)"
    index:
        product: thunderbird
        job-name: win64-enterprise-opt
    attributes:
        enable-build-signing: true
        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
        code-review: true
    treeherder:
        platform: windows2012-64-enterprise-thunderbird/opt
        symbol: Bent
        tier: 1
    worker-type: b-linux-docker-xlarge-amd
    worker:
        max-run-time: 7200
        env:
            PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: cross
            MOZ_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE_TESTS: "1"
            RUST_MIN_STACK: "16777216"
    mozconfig:
        variant: enterprise
        platform: win64
    run:
        actions: [build]
        options: [append-env-variables-from-configs]
        script: mozharness/scripts/fx_desktop_build.py
